name: Wooden Reusable School Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Best Material: The wood board is made of environmental-friendly fiber wood and acrylic plexiglass, nontoxic, odor-free, exquisite craftsmanship & stylish design.
  • Perfect Quality and Durability: Printed in ONE SIDE, and thickness is 8mm. The parts of the product are glued together with a strong glue. Our board is covered with high quality and vivid color printing. The designs are permanently pressed directly onto the decoration, creating, an everlasting image that will NOT peel off or fade. This product can be customized shape.
  • Multi-functional:

The multi-functionality of an acrylic board school sign may include the following features:

  • Information Display: The sign can be used to display important information such as school name, logo, contact details. It serves as a means of identification and communication with students, parents, and teachers.
  • Notice Board: The wooden board can also serve as a notice board to display announcements, upcoming events, important dates, or any other relevant information for students and parents. It provides a centralized location for disseminating important messages.
  • Customization: Wooden board school signs can be easily customized to match the school's branding and design preferences. They can be printed with vibrant colors, school logos, or specific graphics to create a visually appealing and professional-looking signage solution.
  • Gift of love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, The best gift for a child, student.

 

SPECIFICATION

 

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wooden Board

 

PRODUCTION

Print Guidelines

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc.  
  • Download templates and mockups here
  • Template and mockup file guideline video

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill out the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents the “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas that may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
